headline: No Man's Sky launches on iPhone and iPad as part of Indie Games Week
summary: Hello Games' No Man's Sky is coming to iPhone and iPad, available from October 28th on devices as old as the iPhone 11, as part of the App Store's Indie Games Week. Other indie titles including Sifu, Vampire Crawlers, Dome Keeper and Little Kitty, Big City are also joining iOS.
